## 🛒 Retail Sales Data Analytics using Python

### 📘 Overview

An end-to-end **data analytics project** using Python — from data creation to insights and visualization.
It uncovers key trends in retail sales and builds a simple **Linear Regression** model for prediction.

---

### ⚙️ Tools Used

🐍 Python • 📊 Pandas • 🎨 Seaborn • 🤖 Scikit-Learn • 💻 Colab

---

### 📈 Highlights

* Auto-generated retail dataset (no CSV needed)
* Cleaned & analyzed using Pandas
* Colorful charts for sales, payment, and ratings
* Daily sales trend (line graph)
* Simple regression model with 99% accuracy

---

### 🚀 How to Run

1. Open the `.ipynb` file in **Google Colab**
2. Click **Runtime → Run all**
3. View all graphs, insights & model results

---

### 💡 Insights

* Food & Beverages are top sellers 🍔
* E-wallet is the most used payment 💳
* Ratings are balanced ⭐
* Price × Quantity = Total Sales driver 📊
